summary: ProPetro Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on May 4, 2026, announcing its intention to offer $500 million aggregate principal amount of Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers, with up to $75 million additional for overallotment. Net proceeds will partly fund capped call transactions and general corporate purposes, including growth capital for power generation equipment. Simultaneously, ProPetro will amend its ABL credit facility to extend maturity to May 2031, increase revolving commitments to $350 million, and add power generation equipment as a borrowing base component. The filing is a capital markets transaction disclosure, not an event-driven special situation. Watch for pricing terms and note oversubscription risk.
